title: Entity
content: An entity is a distinguishable person, organization, product, place, or concept described by a page or data system.

meta.why: Clear names help a reader distinguish your company from another company or product with a similar name.
meta.example: “Acme inventory software” identifies the product more clearly than switching between “Acme,” “our platform,” and an unrelated abbreviation.
meta.check: Use consistent company and product names, and check that your Organization markup and linked official profiles describe the same business.
meta.limitation: Organization markup can help Google distinguish an organization, although the markup does not guarantee a knowledge panel or control what an AI answer says.
meta.sources: Google Search Central: Organization structured data | https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/structured-data/organization | Platform documentation
